# Glenford Rocks

> Glenford Rocks creates one-of-a-kind outdoor furniture and functional art from Hudson Valley bluestone in Glenford, New York.

## Primary information

- Website: https://glenfordrocks.com/
- Location: Glenford, New York, in the Hudson Valley
- Contact: glenfordsales@hotmail.com
- Work: Custom bluestone benches, chairs, tables, firepits and sculptural pieces
- Material: Hudson Valley bluestone
- Availability: Custom work and visits are discussed directly by email

## About

Glenford Rocks is both a range of outdoor furnishings and a long-term vision for an earth-sculpture park on a former bluestone quarry. Each furniture piece responds to the natural shape and character of its stone.

## Important clarification

Exact dimensions, availability, delivery details and project pricing are provided directly by Glenford Rocks. The website does not publish fixed inventory or pricing.
